description: Enforce Seedance reference caps for image, video, audio, and total media inputs before paid render.
summary: Seedance reference caps must block image > 9, video > 3, audio > 3, and total media > 12.
implementation_notes: Used by ReferencePolicy.validate_reference_caps with deterministic rule IDs for each media type.

description: Assign explicit @Image/@Video/@Audio roles so assets are not used for ambiguous jobs.
summary: Reference assets need a single primary role such as character anchor, product hero, camera motion, action reference, BGM, voice, or SFX.
implementation_notes: Locked user roles win; otherwise tags, notes, prompt context, and media kind infer the safest role.

description: Use time-segmented prompts for long or multi-shot Seedance units instead of compressing many beats into one paragraph.
summary: Prompts around 10s or multi-shot storyboards should expose explicit time windows with camera, action, space, and audio intent.
implementation_notes: The builder segments existing StoryboardScene records and never invents new scenes in Phase 1b.

description: Flag @Image/@Video/@Audio mentions without a nearby role assignment.
summary: A reference tag must state what it controls: character, product, scene, camera, motion, audio, style, or continuity.
implementation_notes: The linter checks a small window around each @ reference tag for known role words.

description: Detect conflicting camera instructions such as static/locked plus orbit/push/pan in one render unit.
summary: Each Seedance shot should have one clear camera intent and no static-vs-motion contradiction.
implementation_notes: The linter treats static and locked as incompatible with active movement tokens in the same camera field.

description: Structure professional video prompts with subject, action, scene, lighting, camera, style, quality, and constraints.
summary: The 8-element prompt formula provides the minimum professional prompt surface for Seedance prompt compilation.
implementation_notes: Formula builder serializes all eight fields; linter flags missing or weak fields.

description: Require stable subject traits so character or product identity does not drift across a shot or storyboard.
summary: Subject text should include 2-3 stable traits when identity, product geometry, or continuity matters.
implementation_notes: The linter checks generic subject labels and stable trait count before render planning.

description: Ensure prompts include no subtitle, no text overlay, no logo, no watermark, and clone/twin risk constraints where needed.
summary: Negative constraints are required to reduce text artifacts, watermark/logo artifacts, and duplicate identity risks.
implementation_notes: Prompt formula inserts standard constraints; linter flags missing constraints in hand-authored prompts.

description: Break complex video requests into 3-5 storyboard shots with beat, camera movement, action, spatial change, audio intent, references, and continuity notes.
summary: Complex Seedance videos should be planned as a small sequence of structured shots rather than one overloaded prompt.
implementation_notes: Phase 2 generator clamps multi-shot plans to 3-5 shots and fills every StoryboardScene field required by compiler tests.
